creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`muster window --watch` prints each line as a pane id and a state (`p1w3r0ab2n  idle`), with no label or given name. An agent knows the ids it is watching, so this costs it nothing; a person running the watch has to cross-reference `muster window` to know which pane moved.

Minor. The plain output could carry the label `muster window` prints; `--json` is fine as it is.
title: window --watch lines name panes by id only
